newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria Danube shipping halted after heavy rain.
newsitem.headline: Austria Danube shipping halted after heavy rain.

text.p: Danube shipping was suspended in Austria on Sunday as days of torrential rain swelled the river.
The river, which flows from the Alps to the Black Sea, was closed to traffic along a 90 km (50 mile) stretch between Linz and Krems, state television reported.
Elsewhere in Austria, flood waters retreated as rainclouds lifted but the emergency services remained on alert, with more showers forecast for Monday.
The northern province of Upper Austria and the Danube basin have so far been worst hit by Austria's worst floods this century.
